## QuietPass: one contact per lookup
1. Set phone, defaultCountry if needed, checks, currency, and maxSpend in Contact and limits. The default checks are free.
2. Select your QuietPass API key as the Bearer Auth credential on both HTTP nodes.
3. Set idempotencyKey to a stable contact-event ID and keep it for retries.
4. For paid checks, set allowPaid=true and a maximum such as "0.05" for both packages. A quote is optional; this workflow runs the lookup directly.
5. If the response is lost, set recoverOnly=true with the same idempotencyKey. Recovery only reads the original status and result.
6. Connect Contact fields to your own CRM or sheet. Only map settled results and preserve null and false. charged_amount is the billed amount, with currency beside it.
https://quietpass.com/integrations/n8n/
